A '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] in [[41 ABY]], when [[Gender/Legends|he]] traveled to a [[frozen moon]] with a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] laboratory.

==Battle on the moon==
[[File:Korr-Riptide.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Jedi Knight Jaden Korr]]
After the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Korr experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] which led him to a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where he found a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Imperial research facility|facility]] where [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had experimented with creating [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] clones decades previously. However, the clones had rebelled and [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at the facility. While exploring the facility, Korr encountered [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], a clone who bore resemblance to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]].

Alpha attempted to kill Korr and feed him to "Mother," a [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]. Korr, however, [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] and defeated Alpha, killing him. In the duel, Korr lost three of the fingers on his right hand as well as the green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] he created upon becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Jaden concluded the duel with the purple-bladed lightsaber he had crafted as a boy, before formal training. During the conclusion of their duel, Alpha's lightsaber shorted out, which left the clone open to Jaden's deathblow. After the deadly confrontation, Jaden considered discarding Alpha's unstable, red-bladed lightsaber, but instead he chose to keep it.

Moments after Jaden had left the cloning facility, he was ambushed by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Kell Douro]]. Douro had tracked Korr down in hopes of drinking his [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]&mdash;of receiving a revelation&mdash;and had incapacitated Korr's newfound friend, [[Khedryn Faal]] before finding and attacking the battle-weakened Korr. Douro overwhelmed the weary Korr and managed to achieve his epiphany just as a recovered Faal arrived. Faal shot the Anzat in the head, killing Douro and saving Korr's life.
